facts.text: The North Star Promise Scholarship Program provides a zero-tuition pathway for eligible Minnesota residents with family Adjusted Gross Income below $80,000 enrolled in at least one credit in a degree, diploma or certificate program.

sources.title: Grants - Bemidji State University
sources.quote: The North Star Promise (NSP) Scholarship Program is a last dollar scholarship program designed to provide a zero-tuition pathway for eligible Minnesota residents pursuing higher education.

sources.title: Grants - Bemidji State University
sources.quote: Students must be Minnesota residents with family Adjusted Gross Income below $80,000 and be enrolled in at least one credit in a degree, diploma or certificate program

facts.text: Bemidji State University's major campus facilities are connected by all-season underground passages for safe travel between classes during cold winter months, and Lake Bemidji serves as an active laboratory for the Aquatic Biology program.

sources.title: Our Community - Bemidji State University
sources.quote: Bemidji State students, faculty and staff have the luxury of enjoying a four-season year with the major campus facilities connected by all-season underground passages for safe and warm travel to and from classes during the cold, winter months.

sources.title: Our Community - Bemidji State University
sources.quote: The deep waters of Lake Bemidji are key to Bemidji State's academic curriculum, acting as a laboratory for the Aquatic Biology program and a backdrop for Studio Art classes.
